wzoSchemeNote: Since the past two decades, the Athornan Mandal along with the W.Z.O. has been helping young full time priests. Under this scheme, monthly remuneration is given to priests on the basis of the type of rituals they are performing. Presently about seventy priests are getting benefit from this scheme.
seniorMobedsNote: The Athornan Mandal also felicitates Senior Mobed Sahebs by awarding a sizeable amount for appreciating their lifetime service of 50 years or more to the Community.
